name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Pixie Dust
description:
Sweet, playful, and a little magical. The Mad Labs Pixie Dust disposable brings a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Pixie Dust is all about bright, sugary-sweet flavor with a fun, candy-like character — a mix of fruity and sweet notes that make every pull light, smooth, and easy to enjoy. It's a flavor-forward crowd-pleaser for anyone who likes their sessions on the sweeter, more playful side.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Pixie Dust flavor — bright, sweet, and candy-fun
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last

Big flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Pixie Dust is ready whenever you are.
